afterToolCall.description: Remind about LitFolio verification after terminal commands

hooks.command:
cat <<'EOF'
Verification reminder for LitFolio:
- Frontend changes: run pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test when appropriate.
- Backend/Rust changes: run cargo test from src-tauri when appropriate.
- E2E-sensitive UI changes: run pnpm test:e2e when feasible.
EOF

afterToolCall.description: Remind about tests and generated-file rules after file creation

hooks.command:
cat <<'EOF'
File creation reminder:
- Add/update nearby tests for new behavior.
- Do not commit generated release notes or extra docs under docs/ except docs/manual/manual.pdf and docs/manual/manual-en.pdf.
- If creating a migration, use the next numbered file in src-tauri/migrations/ and do not rewrite shipped migrations.
EOF

afterToolCall.description: Remind about tests after file edits

hooks.command:
cat <<'EOF'
Edit verification reminder:
- Keep TypeScript API wrappers, schemas, Tauri mocks, and Rust command registration in sync.
- Run focused tests first, then typecheck/lint/test before handoff for substantive changes.
EOF
